Capacity (MW).note: Consumers Energy filed its integrated resource plan application with the Michigan Public Service Commission on September 3, 2026, case U-22127. The application at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002RMFBBAA5 describes a new 919 megawatt natural gas simple cycle plant at the existing Thetford site. The project profile at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002ROXtaAAH gives the same nameplate of 919 megawatts. Both are from the same filing, so this is one source.

Turbine/Engine Technology.note: The Thetford project profile at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002ROXtaAAH lists the technology as a simple cycle combustion turbine.

Fuel.note: The application at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002RMFBBAA5 calls the plant a natural gas simple cycle generating facility.

Start year.note: The Thetford project profile at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002ROXtaAAH gives commercial operation in 2031. This matches the year already in the database.

Status Detail.value: Consumers Energy filed application U-22127 on September 3, 2026 asking for a certificate of necessity for a 919 megawatt natural gas simple cycle plant at its Thetford site in Genesee County, with service planned for 2031. The project profile lists the site as vacant, a prior gas site, and names the Thetford 345 kV substation for interconnection. Source: https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002ROXtaAAH
Status Detail.note: New sentence to place above the existing Status Detail text. It reflects the September 3, 2026 filing.

units.notes: Status stays pre-construction. The project is still moving through the plan review, so Latest Activity is left alone. No link to a specific data center was found. The old Thetford plant is EIA plant 1719 with nine retired units, a different set of units. A Midcontinent Independent System Operator queue entry J3935 for 975.4 megawatts at the Thetford point is a lead only and is not cited.

Latitude.note: The project profile at https://mi-psc.my.site.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/068cs00002ROXtaAAH places the plant at the Thetford site in Thetford Township next to the Thetford 345 kV substation. The point is a cleared vacant pad beside that substation in satellite imagery: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=43.15631,-83.62496

Longitude.note: Same site pick as the latitude.

Location accuracy.note: The site is identified by name and substation, not by a parcel or address, so accuracy stays approximate.

qa.note: Owner stays Consumers Energy Co. The filing says the company would own the plant.

source_log.note: MISO queue data, read October 27, 2026. Request J3935 is gas, simple cycle combustion turbines, 975.4 megawatts, point of interconnection Thetford, Genesee County, queued February 28, 2025, active, in service March 2030.

location.review_note: The current point is about 54 kilometers from the Thetford site named in the filing. The new point is a cleared vacant pad beside the Thetford 345 kV substation, picked from satellite imagery. The filing names the site and the substation but gives no address.
